1.text: Miriyamu na Aroni banegura Mose ku bw'Umunyetiyopiyakazi yarongoye. Koko yari yararongoye Umunyetiyopiyakazi.

2.text: Baravuga bati “Ni ukuri Uwiteka avugira mu kanwa ka Mose musa? Twe ntatuvugiramo?” Uwiteka arabyumva.

3.text: Kandi uwo mugabo Mose yari umugwaneza urusha abantu bo mu isi bose.

4.text: Uwiteka atungura Mose na Aroni na Miriyamu ati “Nimusohoke uko muri batatu, muze ku ihema ry'ibonaniro.” Barasohoka uko ari batatu.

5.text: Uwiteka amanukira mu nkingi y'igicu, ahagarara mu muryango w'Ihema ryera, ahamagara Aroni na Miriyamu, bombi baraza.

6.text: Arababwira ati “Nimwumve amagambo yanjye: niba muri mwe hazabamo umuhanuzi, mu iyerekwa ni ho Uwiteka nzamwimenyeshereza, mu nzozi ni ho nzavuganira na we.

7.text: Umugaragu wanjye Mose si ko ameze, akiranuka mu rugo rwanjye hose.

8.text: Uwo we tujya twivuganira n'akanwa kacu neruye, atari mu migani, kandi ishusho y'Uwiteka ajya ayibona. Nuko ni iki cyabatinyuye kunegura umugaragu wanjye Mose?”

10.text: Cya gicu kiva hejuru y'Ihema ryera kiragenda, Miriyamu asesa ibibembe byera nk'urubura. Aroni ahindukirira Miriyamu, abona asheshe ibibembe.

11.text: Aroni abwira Mose ati “Databuja ndakwingize, we kudushyiraho igihano cy'icyaha twakoreshejwe n'ubupfu, tukizanira urubanza.

12.text: Ndakwingize, ye kumera nk'igihwereye kivutse kiboze mu ruhande rumwe.”

13.text: Mose atakira Uwiteka ati “Mana ndakwingize, mukize.”

14.text: Uwiteka asubiza Mose ati “Iyaba se yamuciriye mu maso gusa, ntiyakozwe n'isoni iminsi irindwi? Bamukingiranire inyuma y'ingando z'amahema, amare iminsi irindwi abone kuhagarurwa.”

15.text: Bakingiranira Miriyamu inyuma y'ingando amara iminsi irindwi, ubwo bwoko ntibwahaguruka, Miriyamu atarahagarurwa.

16.text: Nyuma ubwo bwoko burahaguruka buva i Haseroti, bubamba amahema mu butayu bwa Parani.
